title: Save-safe add-on IDs
message: New item exports now use shorter IDs to prevent save-loading crashes. Re-export older add-ons and their dependent recipes together. Existing saves containing old items need offline migration before loading; re-downloading alone does not repair a save. Keep your original save and add-on backups.
downloadNotice: Use Repair an existing save at the bottom of Help to create a migrated copy on your device. Back up your saves and old add-ons before replacing them.
